description: This file defines a Python class MetricsLogObserver that monitors and logs various performance and usage metrics from MetricsFrame instances in the Pipecat framework, including time to first byte, processing time, token usage, and turn prediction metrics. It acts as an observer for metrics data and outputs formatted logs for monitoring purposes.

classes.name: MetricsLogObserver
classes.description: An observer class that logs metrics data to the console, filtering by included metrics and formatting logs for various metrics types.
